title: Chapter 286 Ancient Battlefield
content:
Chapter 286 Ancient Battlefield

Fortunately, I have no enemies in the fairy world and will basically not be affected by others.

This is the biggest benefit right now.

"My master, I don't think we need to keep a low profile."

At this time, Ao Qing said weakly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue glared at Ao Qing and said, "What does it mean to be low-key? Do you really think you are invincible?"

Ao Qing said nothing on the surface.

But he nodded wildly in his heart.

"By the way, Yuanyuan, why didn't you see her?"

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly spoke.

From the time of coming out to now, I have returned to Zhuyun Peak and have never seen her, which makes Lu Xue a little curious.

Xiao Luo said, "Sister Xue, Miss Yuanyuan left the academy. She said she was going to go out and make a breakthrough."

"What!"

Lu Xue's face looked slightly shocked.

The girl actually left by herself and didn't say hello.

"Oh, she also said you will definitely understand what she means."

"Sister Xue, what does Miss Yuanyuan mean?"

Everyone looked at Lu Xue together.

Hearing this, Lu Xue felt a little unresponsive.

I must understand what she means?

? ? ?

"How could I know."

Lu Xue blurted out.

But after thinking about it, Lu Xue didn't say much.

Because she really doesn't need Yuanyuan yet.

Your own pill is completely enough.

In addition to letting Yuanyuan follow him, except that Yuanyuan is also a person from the deserted city, it is because Yuanyuan is a top alchemist.

A top alchemist can bring not only elixirs, but also influence.

This is what Lu Xue will use in the future.

When everyone heard this, the corners of their mouths twitched slightly.

So, everything is just a random thought of Miss Yuanyuan?

"Sister Xue, do you have any plans next?"

At this time, Xiao Luo suddenly stepped forward and said.

Hearing this, Lu Xue pondered for a moment, "Emm, of course, I'm trying every means to improve my strength now. You also know that our time is precious."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo immediately smiled and said, "That's right, Sister Xue, I have a way to greatly improve our strength, which is that it may be a bit dangerous."

"Oh? You have it? Let's hear it."

I saw Xiao Luo smiled slightly and said mysteriously: "Have you ever heard of the ancient battlefield?"

Ancient battlefield!

Lu Xue and Qin Feng were shocked at the same time.

Seeing the reactions of the two, Xiao Luo was stunned, "You both know?!"

"have no idea."

The two of them said in unison.

"Then why are you surprised!"

Xiao Luo said angrily.

Qin Feng stepped forward and hugged Xiao Luo's shoulder, and smiled and said, "We are catering to the atmosphere."

"Tell me quickly, where is this ancient battlefield that can greatly enhance our strength."

Lu Xue also nodded.

Of course, she had never heard of the ancient battlefield, but she had never heard of it, even Qin Feng, the Tiandi Academy.

You know, Qin Feng has more qualifications in the academy than Xiao Luo.

As for the danger Xiao Luo mentioned, the two obviously didn't care at all.

Seeing this, Xiao Luo coughed lightly and said slowly: "This ancient battlefield can be said to be a place of trial, which is equivalent to some secret realms in the academy, but the difference is that this ancient battlefield has no order. .”

"Inside, you may be in any danger."

"But the same way, you will encounter unthinkable opportunities."

Hearing this, Lu Xue and Qin Feng looked at each other, both frowned slightly.

"I said Xiao Luo, you won't be in the frame of us, right? Is this ancient battlefield so magical? Why have I never heard of it?"

If it were true as Xiao Luo said, then this ancient battlefield should have been well-known to people in the Immortal Realm, especially their Tiandi Academy, which should definitely be used to train students in the academy.

"Xiao Luo, this ancient battlefield is not your family, right?"

At this time, Lu Xue asked.

"Haha, Sister Xue is still smart."

"Damn it, it's really your home!"

Qin Feng stared at Xiao Luo with wide eyes. Is the Xiao family so hidden?

The Xiao family rose in an instant not long ago, and now another ancient battlefield has exploded.

Damn the second generation of immortals!

"Low, low-key."

Xiao Luo stroked his hand with a look of beating, and then said, "Actually, it's not my family's. Although my Xiao clan is indeed strong now, it is not as strong as a force to control an ancient battlefield."

After a pause, Xiao Luo suddenly lowered his voice and whispered: "It's better not to spread this matter as much as possible. If it's learned about it by outsiders, it's over."

Hearing this, Lu Xue and the others also looked solemn.

"Brother Xiao, don't worry, my mouth is absolutely strict."

"Oh, don't keep it aside, say it quickly."

Lu Xue poked Xiao Luo and signaled him to continue.

Seeing this, Xiao Luo no longer hesitated.

"This ancient battlefield, in fact,"

"who!"

At this moment, a mutation broke out.

Lu Xue suddenly turned around and looked at the corner.

The next moment, the temperature in the field dropped sharply.

Xiao Luo and Qin Feng were shocked and quickly entered a state of fighting.

"come out!"

Lu Xue shouted coldly.

At the same time, Ao Qing also stood up and looked in front of him with awesome momentum.

Under the influence of Ao Qing's Dragon Power, an illusory figure slowly emerged from the corner.

"You are really not easy."

A strong yin energy overflowed from the shadow's body.

The temperature in the field dropped sharply again.

Faced with the phantom's praise, Lu Xue just snorted coldly.

At this moment, the phantom looked at Xiao Luo, "I already know what you said."

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo looked shocked, "What! You know about the ancient battlefield!!"

Xiao Luo's voice was extremely loud and he wished he could spread throughout Zhuyun Peak.

Qin Feng, who was standing beside him, suddenly stepped forward and covered Xiao Luo's mouth, for fear that he would continue to speak.

"Are you stupid? This guy is lying to you at first glance!"

Lu Xue also looked at Xiao Luo with a look of regret.

We didn't let us leak it just now, but in a blink of an eye, you guy said it himself.

This IQ is not as good as Ao Qing.

At this moment, Xiao Luo also realized that he had let go. After being sad, his eyes looking at the phantom were immediately filled with murderous intent.

laugh!

In response to this, Xiao Luo rushed directly towards the phantom, and his aura of the Immortal Saint Realm was not concealed at all.

Obviously, he is preparing for a killing one blow.

As long as the other party dies, it will be useless even if you know it.

However, Xiao Luo underestimated the strength of the Phantom.

Bang!

With a loud bang, Xiao Luo was directly bombarded by the same road. Although it was nothing serious, he still felt a little uncomfortable.

"The peak of the Immortal Saint Realm."

Lu Xue looked at the phantom in the distance, her expression slightly condensed.

"My little master, I'll kill him for you."

At this time, Ao Qing spoke and was about to kill the phantom.

But Lu Xue stopped him.

"No need, killing him is useless, it's just a clone."

"What!"

Xiao Luo and the others were shocked again.

The phantom in front of me was not the original body.

If the original body is not already so strong, then the original body will be more desirable.

Moreover, how did this guy sneak into Zhuyun Peak.

Is there no one in the academy?

But then, the few people realized that it was impossible for the academy to be left without people, so there was only one possibility that the guy in front of him was also from the Tiandi Academy.

"Damn it, if Sister Yin wasn't there, otherwise, how could you, a villain, be so arrogant?"

Xiao Luo gritted his teeth.
